## Growth of functions
:::

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [Big-O](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/recurrences-growth.html#def-big-o) ($c \in \bbR$; $N, n \in \bbZ$) | $(f(n) = O(g(n))) \Leftrightarrow (\exists c > 0, \exists N, \forall n \ge N, \abs{f(n)} \le c \abs{g(n)})$ |
| [Big-Omega](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/recurrences-growth.html#def-big-omega) | $(f(n) = \Omega(g(n))) \Leftrightarrow (\exists c > 0, \exists N, \forall n \ge N, \abs{f(n)} \ge c \abs{g(n)})$ |
| [Big-Theta](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/recurrences-growth.html#def-big-theta) | $(f(n) = \Theta(g(n))) \Leftrightarrow ((f(n) = O(g(n))) \land (f(n) = \Omega(g(n))))$ |
| Witnesses | the numbers $c$ and $N$ |
